text: 12 points Short answers! Consider the following problems. For each problem, determine if it is possible that there exists a polynomial-time algorithm for solving that problem. Justify your answer using what is currently know about their complexity classes. e Travelling salesman problem e n X n chess e The Halting Problem e Vertex Cover o Integer Factorization o Given a set of n items, where each item has a specific weight, can we pack them onto K trucks where each truck can hold at most weight B.
